잠언 22:1.content: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.

잠언 22:2.content: The rich and poor meet together: the Lord is the maker of them all.

잠언 22:3.content: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.

잠언 22:4.content: By humility and the fear of the Lord are riches, and honour, and life.

잠언 22:5.content: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.

잠언 22:6.content: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

잠언 22:7.content: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

잠언 22:8.content: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.

잠언 22:9.content: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.

잠언 22:10.content: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.

잠언 22:11.content: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.

잠언 22:12.content: The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.

잠언 22:13.content: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.

잠언 22:14.content: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the Lord shall fall therein.

잠언 22:15.content: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

잠언 22:16.content: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.

잠언 22:17.content: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.

잠언 22:18.content: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.

잠언 22:19.content: That thy trust may be in the Lord, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.

잠언 22:20.content: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

잠언 22:21.content: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?

잠언 22:22.content: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:

잠언 22:23.content: For the Lord will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.

잠언 22:24.content: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:

잠언 22:25.content: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

잠언 22:26.content: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.

잠언 22:27.content: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

잠언 22:28.content: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.

잠언 22:29.content: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
